hook: Telangana ranks *No. 1* in India for HIV control
hook_b: Telangana ranks *No. 1* in India for HIV control
tldr: Under NACO's Mobilisation for AIDS Suraksha programme, 31 of Telangana's 33 districts hit 'Surakshit' status, a 94% success rate, per the national dashboard as of Nov 25.

beats.what: Telangana posted a 94% success rate on the national MAS dashboard, ahead of Maharashtra (92%) and West Bengal (83%).
beats.why: Districts are rated against the 95:95:99 targets for testing, treatment and viral suppression.
beats.care: Two districts still need to meet all three targets, the health minister told officials.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Health minister Damodar Rajanarsimha directed officials to focus on the remaining two districts.

cards.q: Should HIV awareness be part of college orientation?

qs: Which two districts are yet to reach Surakshit status?

facts.t: *260* districts nationally are still in the lowest 'Sangharshsheel' category.

viz.verdict: Telangana leads the states; the national share is far lower.

learn.t: 95:95:99 = 95% of people with HIV know their status, 95% of them get treatment, 99% of those reach viral suppression

watch: Whether the last two districts reach Surakshit status.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Telangana tops HIV control with 31 districts rated safe

fact: Telangana tops India in HIV control with *31 of 33* districts rated safe
twist: Nationally only *35%* of districts, 273 of 784, have reached the same status.
